purpose: Prevent unlabeled structural components from silently becoming background in a wall-capable column/beam/wall detector.

current_review_inventory.note: Counts are review inventory, not ground truth. The 13 high-recall records passed mechanical/source-geometry/provenance gates but remain blocked by human instance QA.

current_blockers: Wall QA remains incomplete at instance-bbox level: 14/14 pilot pages have page-level review, but the two human-confirmed structural-wall-positive pages still need reviewed wall instance boxes.
The combined known review inventory is 29 records (4 column, 25 beam, 0 wall); zero wall records means it cannot train a three-class detector.
Final human approval remains pending for the 16 baseline beam/column candidates and all 13 high-recall Lacmark Mx201 beam candidates.
Unreviewed or no-safe-box target-class regions must not be converted to background/negative labels.
required_before_wall_capable_training: Create and human-review tight source-page wall instance candidates on the confirmed wall-positive pages.
Complete human instance QA for promotable beam/column review candidates, including the 13 Lacmark Mx201 candidates.
Re-review training pages for unlabeled column/beam/wall instances before background eligibility.
Run validation, cross-split duplicate, provenance, and source-page regressions before dataset release.
note: This gate is a dataset/training-safety artifact only. It does not activate ontology v0.2, approve wall handoff, or create Core entities/engineering geometry.
